name: Solar Energy
description: Vast desert spaces with exceptional solar irradiance, perfect for grid-connected gigawatt-scale solar farms.

name: Desert Tourism
description: Berber ksour and stunning Sahara dunes, attracting international eco-tourists and luxury wilderness camps.

name: Oasis Agriculture
description: Localized desert farming using modern water preservation to harvest high-yield figs, olives, and forage crops.

name: Tourism
description: Pristine sandy beaches and coastal resorts, generating massive European and domestic tourism flows.

name: Citrus Agriculture
description: Cap Bon accounts for over 70% of national citrus production, offering top-tier orange, lemon, and essential oil exports.

name: Handicrafts
description: A world-renowned ceramics, pottery, and stone-carving sector supporting hundreds of export-oriented workshops.

name: Maritime Economy
description: Strategically positioned on deepwater shipping lines, hosting state-owned ship repair yards and yacht builders.

name: Fishing
description: An abundant Mediterranean fishing fleet with advanced aquaculture operations in the Bizerte Lagoon.

name: Industry
description: The Bizerte Free Zone acts as a competitive duty-free manufacturing base for aviation and automotive parts.

name: Tourism
description: Known as the Pearl of the Sahel, hosting dynamic resorts, historical medina sites, and premium yacht marinas.

name: Industry
description: Leading electronics assembly plants and specialized textile factories operating near the commercial port.

name: Technology
description: Novation City mechatronics cluster fostering hardware-focused startups, R&D labs, and software developers.

name: Fintech & Services
description: The absolute banking, financial, and regulatory center of Tunisia, holding most of the tech venture funding.

name: Olive Oil Production
description: Tunisia's main olive oil capital. Holds millions of trees and hosts advanced refining and packaging plants.

name: Date Palms
description: Home to authentic Deglet Nour dates, packing the highest quality honey-dates exported globally.
